parsed.internal_thinking: Hadar is frustrated because the 9 roll benefited me while her 9 (Hex 14) remains blocked. I have 5 wheat and need one more ore for a city. Giving her wheat now would help her build and make the robber placement look even more like a targeted betrayal rather than a strategic 'balance'. I need to maintain the stance that Ziv is the one benefiting from her focus on me while I'm just trying to keep the game competitive.
parsed.note_to_self: Hadar is very hostile about the Hex 14 block. Ziv is successfully fueling her resentment. I have 5 wheat and 2 ore; I must get that 3rd ore for a city on Node 44 or 12 to pull ahead.
parsed.say_outloud: הדר, זה לא אישי. ה-9 הזה פשוט חוסם גם את זיו, שמקבל אבן בכל פעם שיוצא 5. אם אני אתן לך חיטה עכשיו, זיו פשוט יסגור איתך עסקה וייבנה על חשבון שנינו. אני מנסה למנוע ממנו לברוח.
